offerings.name: Governance Assessment
offerings.customer_outcome: A source- and evidence-bound map of an existing workflow, its authoritative states, decision boundaries, allowed transitions, failure conditions, and a governed target-state implementation plan.
offerings.authority_boundary: Commercial description and assessment only; applicable customer, StegVerse, legal, credential, operational, execution and release authorities remain separate.

offerings.name: Governance & AI Boundary Validation
offerings.source_product: StegVerse Governance & AI Boundary Validation Engine
offerings.customer_outcome: Deterministically validate a declared governance manifest against a proposed or recorded execution context and return machine-readable findings plus a human-readable audit report.
offerings.authority_boundary: Validation does not create execution authority, payment/custody authority, identity, legal certification, token authority, or a hosted control plane.

offerings.name: Admitted Code
offerings.source_product: Admitted Code assessment / StegGate-backed admissibility design
offerings.customer_outcome: Bind a proposed code/change identity, target, admission predicates and evidence requirements before any separately authorized consequential execution.
offerings.authority_boundary: StegCore source and ICV gateway candidates do not by themselves establish a released production admission service; production authority, distribution, trust-root and custody remain separately governed.

offerings.name: StegGate
offerings.customer_outcome: Submit a structured commitment candidate through the canonical StegCore admissibility composition and receive a governed disposition, reasons, predicate matrix and reconstruction hashes.
offerings.authority_boundary: The 0.3.0 source line is current and validated but the canonical handoff states v0.3.0 NOT YET RELEASED. An evaluation is not proof of execution and does not mint authority, identity, custody or continuity.

offerings.name: StegCRM
offerings.customer_outcome: Project commercial relationships across existing campaign, CRM, email, repository and operational sources while preserving source authority and evidence lineage.
offerings.authority_boundary: Projection authority remains NONE; source systems retain authority and no write-back, generic probability or qualification synthesis is implied.

offerings.name: HydraSafe Permitting-Readiness
offerings.customer_outcome: Assemble and check a structured facility evidence packet for hydrogen/reactive-gas permitting and qualified-professional review.
offerings.authority_boundary: HydraSafe does not issue permits, provide legal advice, perform engineering design, certify code compliance, stamp engineering work or authorize facility operation.

offerings.name: GP10 Field Validation
offerings.customer_outcome: Normalize a customer-authorized locomotive or parts-history evidence package, preserve provenance/conflicts, apply deterministic validation and return an evidence packet with unresolved questions and next-evidence recommendations.
offerings.authority_boundary: The service does not establish safety, regulatory, emissions, fitment, pricing, profitability, repair, retrofit, commissioning, purchase or release authority beyond supplied evidence and applicable qualified review.

offerings.name: Governance Observatory
offerings.customer_outcome: Capture, compare and publish source-bound observations of external governance, evidentiary, runtime and admissibility frameworks using reproducible artifacts and explicit publication boundaries.
offerings.authority_boundary: Release does not imply endorsement, certification, standing, execution authorization, partnership or authority transfer; the repository records observations and does not grant execution authority.

offerings.name: KnowledgeVault / MyKV
offerings.customer_outcome: Create portable owner-controlled knowledge/continuity vaults with installation receipts, multi-instance identity, bounded relationship state and reconstructable provenance without requiring a hosted service.
offerings.authority_boundary: File/source tooling does not establish provider access, synchronization, AI corpus exposure, storage authority or relationship transitions without separately admitted evidence and authority.

offerings.name: StegTalk
offerings.customer_outcome: Demonstrate the current device-agnostic communication architecture and local messaging/runtime surfaces under bounded prototype conditions.
offerings.authority_boundary: Canonical release verification states verified_non_production_local_prototype and production_ready=false; no production transport, cryptography, deployment standing or final governance authority is claimed.

offerings.name: Ecosystem Chat
offerings.source_product: Ecosystem Chat governed conversational capability interface
offerings.customer_outcome: Present a governed conversational interface that can discover and compose provider capabilities while retaining provider identity, provenance and governance boundaries.
offerings.authority_boundary: Source positioning is released, but live distributed multi-LLM execution and live AI SiteFlow integration are explicitly NOT YET IMPLEMENTED / NOT PROVEN.

offerings.name: StegLearn
offerings.customer_outcome: Capture learner curiosity, activity and explanation, support parent review, and preserve structured learning receipts and portfolio records.
offerings.authority_boundary: The current source defines and materializes bounded learning flows; it does not establish a generally released education platform, legal homeschool compliance automation or AI authority over the learner.

offerings.name: StegBusiness / StegBusiness-Ops
offerings.customer_outcome: Internal canonical business identity/lifecycle and operational coordination supporting formation, tax, procurement, contracts, finance, compliance, insurance, licensing and renewals.
offerings.authority_boundary: Current ownership is StegVerse business administration substrate. Repository preparation does not create legal formation, filing, certification, award, payment, banking or external portal authority; no independent customer-facing ICV package is claimed here.
